# ConvertSheet: Full Technical Reference & Tool Catalog

> Complete catalog of in-browser data converters, mathematical financial engines, developer utilities, embed widgets, and programmatic calculations. Built by Priyanshu Rawat. 100% Client-Side WebAssembly. Zero Server Uploads.

## 1. System Overview
- **Domain:** https://www.convertsheet.com
- **License/Model:** Free, Zero Registration, No Data Collection.
- **Compute Architecture:** Client-side execution in Chromium/WebKit/Gecko JavaScript & WebAssembly runtimes.
- **Key Libraries:**
  - DuckDB-Wasm (columnar database engine compiled from C++ to WebAssembly)
  - SheetJS (spreadsheet binary parsing and XLSX/CSV generation)
  - PDF-Lib (client-side PDF document manipulation)
  - Apache Arrow (zero-copy in-memory columnar data transport)

## 2. Embeddable Widgets API (/embed)
ConvertSheet provides free, responsive iframe widgets for third-party websites, blogs, and portals. Any tool can be embedded using the standard URL pattern:
`https://www.convertsheet.com/embed/{toolSlug}?theme=auto|light|dark`

### Example Embed Implementation:
```html
<iframe 
  src="https://www.convertsheet.com/embed/mortgage-calculator" 
  width="100%" 
  height="650" 
  frameborder="0" 
  style="border: none; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;" 
  loading="lazy" 
  title="Mortgage Calculator Widget">
</iframe>
```

## 3. All Data Converters

### JSON to Excel (/convert/json-to-excel)
- **Input:** JSON files (`.json`, `.txt`) or raw pasted text. Deeply nested objects and arrays supported.
- **Output:** Native Excel workbook (`.xlsx`) with automated dot-notation column flattening.
- **Security:** In-memory browser parsing. No HTTP server transmission.

### SQLite to Excel (/convert/sqlite-to-excel)
- **Input:** SQLite 3 binary database files (`.sqlite`, `.db`, `.sqlite3`, `.db3`).
- **Output:** Multi-sheet Excel workbook (`.xlsx`) where each database table becomes a dedicated worksheet tab.
- **Engine:** In-memory WebAssembly SQLite engine.

### CSV to Excel (/convert/csv-to-excel)
- **Input:** Comma-separated or delimiter-separated text (`.csv`, `.tsv`, `.txt`).
- **Output:** Formatted Excel workbook (`.xlsx`) with numeric type coercion.

### Excel to CSV (/convert/excel-to-csv)
- **Input:** Excel workbooks (`.xlsx`, `.xls`).
- **Output:** Standard UTF-8 CSV text files with sheet selection.

### Excel to JSON (/convert/excel-to-json)
- **Input:** Excel workbooks (`.xlsx`, `.xls`).
- **Output:** Formatted JSON array of objects with downloadable `.json` file or copyable output.

### Parquet to Excel (/convert/parquet-to-excel)
- **Input:** Apache Parquet columnar files (`.parquet`).
- **Output:** Excel workbook (`.xlsx`) with vectorized DuckDB-Wasm row group streaming.

### Parquet to CSV (/convert/parquet-to-csv)
- **Input:** Columnar Apache Parquet files (`.parquet`).
- **Output:** Standard CSV text stream with SQL projection options.

### JSONL to Excel (/convert/jsonl-to-excel)
- **Input:** Newline-delimited JSON (`.jsonl`, `.ndjson`).
- **Output:** Multi-row Excel spreadsheet (`.xlsx`).

### JSON to NDJSON (/convert/json-to-ndjson)
- **Input:** JSON arrays (`.json`).
- **Output:** Streaming line-delimited records (`.ndjson`) for LLM finetuning, Elasticsearch, and vector databases.

### XML to Excel (/convert/xml-to-excel)
- **Input:** XML documents (`.xml`).
- **Output:** Tabular Excel workbook (`.xlsx`) with hierarchical node extraction.

### Tally XML to Excel (/convert/tally-xml-to-excel)
- **Input:** Tally ERP 9 / TallyPrime XML export files (`.xml`).
- **Output:** Excel spreadsheets configured for accounting ledgers, vouchers, and trial balances.

## 4. Financial Calculation Models

### Salary & Take-Home Pay (/tools/salary-calculator)
- **US Tax Engine:** 2026 IRS Federal Brackets (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, 37%), Standard Deduction ($14,600 Single / $29,200 Married), FICA Social Security (6.2% up to $168,600) and Medicare (1.45% + 0.9% Additional Medicare surtax over $200k).
- **India Tax Engine:** FY 2024-25 / 2025-26 New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC) with ₹75,000 standard deduction, Section 87A rebate (zero tax up to ₹7,00,000 net taxable income) and marginal relief, plus 4% Health & Education Cess. Old Tax Regime with 80C, 80D, and HRA deductions.

### Mortgage & Amortization (/tools/mortgage-calculator)
- **Formula:** M = P [ i(1 + i)^n ] / [ (1 + i)^n – 1 ]
- **Features:** Complete monthly/yearly amortization schedule, extra principal payments, PMI cancellation thresholds, and downloadable Excel amortization schedule.
- **Embed URL:** https://www.convertsheet.com/embed/mortgage-calculator

### Car Loan Payment Calculator (/tools/car-loan-calculator)
- **Formula:** Auto financing formula factoring vehicle purchase price, down payment, trade-in equity, sales tax, dealer fees, and loan term (36 to 84 months).
- **Embed URL:** https://www.convertsheet.com/embed/car-loan-calculator

### Home Loan Overdraft vs Prepayment (/tools/home-loan-overdraft-calculator)
- **Model:** SBI MaxGain and overdraft home loan mechanics. Compares parking emergency funds in an interest-offset account vs direct principal prepayment, factoring in interest rate spreads (typically 25–40 bps).
- **Embed URL:** https://www.convertsheet.com/embed/home-loan-overdraft-calculator

### Interest Rate Hike & Loan Tenure Trap (/tools/interest-rate-hike-calculator)
- **Model:** Calculates how bank rate hikes (e.g. RBI repo rate revisions) extend home loan duration rather than increasing EMIs, demonstrating the compounding tenure trap and the "1 extra EMI per year" payoff rule.

### Retirement Nest Egg & 401(k) (/tools/retirement-calculator)
- **Model:** Dual-phase accumulation and decumulation models. Compound investment growth, employer match, inflation-adjusted purchasing power, and safe withdrawal rate (4% rule).

### UK Salary & PAYE (/tools/uk-salary-calculator)
- **HMRC Brackets:** Personal Allowance (£12,570, tapered £1 for every £2 earned above £100,000), Basic rate 20% (£12,571–£50,270), Higher rate 40% (£50,271–£125,140), Additional rate 45% (>£125,140).
- **National Insurance:** Class 1 primary rate (8% between £12,570 and £50,270, 2% above £50,270).

### Canada Paycheck (/tools/canada-paycheck-calculator)
- **CRA Federal Brackets:** 15%, 20.5%, 26%, 29%, 33%.
- **Provincial Brackets:** Ontario (ON), British Columbia (BC), Alberta (AB), Quebec (QC).
- **Mandatory Contributions:** CPP + CPP2 and EI caps.

### Australia Pay (/tools/australia-pay-calculator)
- **ATO Stage 3 Tax Cuts:** 0–$18,200 (0%), $18,201–$45,000 (16%), $45,001–$135,000 (30%), $135,001–$190,000 (37%), >$190,000 (45%).
- **Superannuation:** 11.5% employer super guarantee contribution.

### Inflation & Purchasing Power (/tools/inflation-calculator)
- **Future Value:** FV = PV × (1 + r)^t
- **Real Purchasing Power:** RealValue = PV / (1 + r)^t
